entries.rf.moon_shift: At {time} the Moon moves into {rashi}, and the feel of the day shifts gently with it.
entries.rf.ingress: {graha} enters {rashi} at {time}. A new phase begins for the areas it touches, so allow a little time to settle in.
entries.rf.retro: {graha} is retrograde now. This suits review, repair and finishing what has already been started.
entries.rf.dasha_lord: The current dasha period is ruled by {graha}, so its themes run quietly through the day.
entries.rf.chandrashtama: The Moon is in the eighth sign from the natal Moon today. Keep plans light, rest well and leave big decisions for another day.
entries.rf.sadesati.rising: Saturn is in the sign before the natal Moon, the opening phase of Sade Sati. A time to build patient habits and plan steadily.
entries.rf.sadesati.peak: Saturn is over the natal Moon sign, the middle phase of Sade Sati. Steady effort, simple routines and kindness to oneself help.
entries.rf.sadesati.setting: Saturn is in the sign after the natal Moon, the closing phase of Sade Sati. A good time to finish and consolidate.
entries.rf.sadesati.dhaiya_4th: Saturn is in the fourth sign from the natal Moon, a Dhaiya phase. Home matters welcome patient, regular attention.
entries.rf.sadesati.dhaiya_8th: Saturn is in the eighth sign from the natal Moon, a Dhaiya phase. Go slowly with changes and keep routines steady.
entries.rf.tara.t1: Today's star falls in {tara:1} tara, the birth star itself. A familiar day for keeping to a natural rhythm.
entries.rf.tara.t2: Today's star falls in {tara:2} tara, linked with resources. A good day to tend savings and things of value.
entries.rf.tara.t3: Today's star falls in {tara:3} tara. Plans may want a second look, so keep the day simple and flexible.
entries.rf.tara.t4: Today's star falls in {tara:4} tara, linked with wellbeing. A pleasant day for care of home and health.
entries.rf.tara.t5: Today's star falls in {tara:5} tara. Patience in talks helps, and small disagreements pass when left alone.
entries.rf.tara.t6: Today's star falls in {tara:6} tara, linked with effort. Steady work on a chosen goal feels rewarding.
entries.rf.tara.t7: Today's star falls in {tara:7} tara. Treat it as a day for rest and care, with a lighter schedule.
entries.rf.tara.t8: Today's star falls in {tara:8} tara, linked with friendship. A warm day for meeting friends and offering help.
entries.rf.tara.t9: Today's star falls in {tara:9} tara, linked with close friendship. A gentle day for shared work and goodwill.
